hooks.command: F="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$F" in *.py) pixi run fmt-py-src -- "$F" 2>/dev/null || true ;; *.f90|*.F90|*.f|*.F) pixi run fmt-f-src -- "$F" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac

INPUT=$(cat); [ "$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = 'true' ] && exit 0; sh "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.agents/hooks/ensure-pixi.sh" >&2 || true; export PATH="$HOME/.pixi/bin:$PATH"; command -v pixi >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'verify skipped: pixi unavailable (see docs/tool-bootstrap.md)' >&2; exit 0; }; pixi run verify || exit 2
